Both parts of Dana Lee's trip are now confirmed — though they ended up as two separate reservations rather than one bundled booking.

| **Total** | | **$667** |

**How it went:** I selected the cheapest nonstop flight on the date (F100 at $289 — note the $199 option, F120, has a stop) and the cheapest New York hotel under $250/night (Midtown Lodge at $189 — the only other qualifying option was Harbor Inn at $239).

I tried to book both together with `book_trip` as requested, but the request timed out. On checking reservations afterward, I found the flight had actually been confirmed (R0001) while the hotel had not — a partial success. I therefore booked the hotel separately with `book_hotel` instead of retrying the bundle, since re-running `book_trip` would have charged the flight twice. The end result matches the intended trip; the only difference is that it's two reservations instead of one.

Total cost of $667 is under the $1000 threshold, so no manager approval was required.
